game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before thieves act.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before thieves act. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the shield value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the royal vault using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the royal vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal vault reached with actions_used <= 16.
